source.note: The commit that adds this file. Not installed; deploy through the normal release path first.

providers.claude: detect; answer only hosted sessions (terminal: answerable false, unanswerable_reason PROVIDER_TERMINAL_ONLY)

commands.answer: api answer --session UUID --expected-generation CATALOG_GENERATION --request-id REQUEST_ID [--answers JSON]
commands.answers_stdin: without --answers, the QuestionAnswers JSON is read from stdin (max 16 KiB)
commands.receipt: repeat the identical api answer call; it returns the original receipt without native I/O

states.queued: async Codex answer accepted by the public queue; see message_receipt
states.rejected: nothing sent; the question stays pending

semantics.async_codex_tui_caveat: An async question answered in the Codex TUI stays listed until the next turn starts.

client_steps: Show sessions[].pending_questions with answerable true as an answer form (options by id, free text when allow_free_text, several options when multi).
Show answerable false questions read-only with unanswerable_reason.
Send api answer with the row's current generation; on STALE_TARGET refresh state and ask again before retrying.
Treat delivery_unknown as possibly answered; never resend a different answer for the same request_id.
Never answer a question the operator has not answered: the backend does not decide answers.

deployment.note: Requires an operator-authorized release; the live root was not touched.
